method.summaryStatistic: Median of four per-process medians per view and arm; ranges are the min/max of those four process medians. The callbacks within a process are not independent experimental units.

sourceReview.status: plausible contributor; not attributed by phase data
sourceReview.comparison: At measured c04 baseline, SelectionChanged performs split mirror synchronization, math preview derivation, and selection-tool placement. Current candidate additionally derives and publishes heading, caret position, current-block/list, and find facts.
sourceReview.mechanism: Current selectionFactsAnalysis compares activity.changes. Changed increments activity.changes immediately before invoking SelectionChanged, so committed edits enter its expanded derived-presentation block. A changed position label reaches Label::SetText, which invalidates measure, requests a window-host accessibility snapshot refresh, and invalidates paint; measure preparation is deferred and the ordinary stable-focus accessibility flush is posted/coalesced.
sourceReview.boundary: The Selection bucket times the whole method. Caret line/column, selection length, EOL, pending math, focus and search facts need fresh values; current evidence neither isolates Label::SetText nor assigns the measured delta to this path.
sourceReview.apiFinding: No general BeginUpdate/EndUpdate or Label notification batch API was found in the current SDK surface. Existing batching is host pending-measure state and one coalesced posted accessibility flush.
sourceReview.testRecommendation: If investigated, split diagnostics within SelectionChanged only after preserving tests for caret movement across CRLF and mixed EOL, Unicode ACP positions, pending math, selection gestures, and UIA value freshness. No source change is proposed here.

independentAudit.result: All retained native reports and source/receipt bindings passed the independent descriptive audit.
